summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting its ongoing share buy-back program, announced 5 August 2026, executed through BNP Paribas Financial Markets. On 19 August 2026, HSBC repurchased 3,000,000 shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average price of 15.1251 GBP, and 370,400 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at HK$160.2702 average, for cancellation. Cumulative repurchases since commencement total 16,118,414 shares for US$332.4 million. Issued share capital now stands at 17,171,436,783. Shares were bought on-market; cancellation on HK exchange pending. Watch for continued buy-back pace and capital return updates.
